correctness.rationale: Verified every essential inference independently. Oddness of dp,dOmega and beta=12e1=-6(10+d^2) follow from sigma-invariance and principal-part matching; normalization reduces to b=-J3/J1, delta=-(12J5+beta J3)/J1 with Jk over [1,3] (outer bands coincide, middle vanishes). Re-ran verify_identity.py: collision numerator factors as (s1-s2)[12 s1 s2+12b(s1+s2)+b beta-delta] and substitution gives H=12G/J1 with beta cancelling identically, G=J5-(s1+s2)J3+s1 s2 J1. Sign table on (1,3) is strict: E>0, (E^2-9)<0, (E^2-1)>0, (E^2-d^2)>0, zeros only at endpoints or E=d outside, integrable |E-Ej|^-1/2 singularities, so G(9,1)<0, G(9,d^2)<0, G(1,d^2)>0 for all d in (0,1). Denominator bound b in (-9,-1) as weighted mean of E^2 in (1,9) under positive measure E w dE is strict, so 9+b>0, 1+b<0, d^2+b<0. Hence three reduced speeds V(s)=(12s^2+beta s+delta)/(s+b) at s=9,1,d^2 are real, finite, pairwise distinct. Recomputed band-normalized speeds (up to irrelevant 1/12 scale matching DRAFT table: e.g. d=0.05 gives 77.17,30.77,10.94 vs table 6.4306,2.5648,0.9117) confirming distinct ordered speeds; gap-normalization variant also stays collision-free. No proof/experiment confusion: analytic proof, numerics illustrative only.
